subject: maths
question: In an examination, there were three papers of Mathematics, two papers of English and one paper of Science. All papers were of 100 marks. S got 60% in Mathematics, 70% in English and 50% in Science. What was his percentage of marks in all papers?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using the weighted average method for percentage over the ratio of the number of papers:

Ratio of papers = 3 (Maths) : 2 (English) : 1 (Science)

Overall Percentage = (3 × 60% + 2 × 70% + 1 × 50%) ÷ (3 + 2 + 1)

⇒ Overall Percentage = (180% + 140% + 50%) ÷ 6 = 370% ÷ 6

⇒ Overall Percentage ≈ 61.67%

**∴ The correct answer is 61.67%.**

**Given:**
